visual.zh: 琥珀色横带被一道细纤维竖膜分隔，少量粒点与短连接穿过开口，右侧聚起气泡。黑白版保持同一横带、竖膜和气泡关系；这是一幅想象的剖视。
visual.en: A fine vertical fiber membrane divides an amber band. A few dots and short bridges cross its openings, with bubbles gathering to the right. The neutral edition preserves the same band, membrane and bubbles. This is an imagined cutaway.

background.zh:
哈登与汉斯·冯·欧拉-切尔平共享1929年诺贝尔化学奖，各占一半，因研究糖的发酵及发酵酶。哈登与威廉·杨的研究表明，酵母提取物的发酵需要可透过膜的小分子因素等共同参与。画面借分隔与重新协作表达这一线索，并非历史装置复原或分子图；短句为原创。
1929年化学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他们对糖的发酵与发酵酶的研究。
background.en:
Harden shared the 1929 Nobel Prize in Chemistry equally with Hans von Euler-Chelpin for work on sugar fermentation and fermentative enzymes. Harden and William Young showed that fermentation in yeast extracts depended on cooperating components, including a small diffusible factor. The image uses separation and cooperation as an original metaphor, not a historical apparatus or molecular diagram. The phrase is original.
1929 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: for their investigations on the fermentation of sugar and fermentative enzymes
